name: Human Brain (Cerebrum, Cerebellum & Brainstem)
semanticDescription: Anatomically accurate 3D model of the human brain showing Cerebrum with cortical gyri ridges and sulci furrows (Frontal, Parietal, Temporal, and Occipital lobes), Cerebellum with horizontal folia striping, Brainstem (Midbrain, Pons, Medulla Oblongata, Spinal Cord), C-shaped commissural arch of Corpus Callosum, Thalamus, and Hypothalamus with Infundibulum and Pituitary Gland.
simplifications: Medial sagittal section exposes deep commissural and diencephalic anatomy (corpus callosum, thalamus, hypothalamus) and brainstem
Cerebral cortical gyri and sulci generated via procedural multi-frequency 3D sinusoidal noise displacement
Cerebellar folia modeled with characteristic horizontal transverse striping

materials.look: Gray matter cerebral cortex with subsurface scattering (pink-beige)
Brainstem nerve tracts and cranial projections with subsurface scattering
White matter commissural tract arch with subsurface scattering

provenance.source: NCERT Class 10/11 Biology Benchmarks & Procedural Geometry
